reasoning: The extractor and Judge 2 read the same passages correctly: the only score analysed is one Exercise Motivation composite, and the paper never says how it was built from six subscales that include amotivation and external regulation. The paper tests groups only by a group main effect and a time x group interaction, and gives no post-intervention between-group test. Section 7 says a composite with a between-group test decides. It defines favouring only for named constructs, not for a composite of unstated valence, and it does not say whether an interaction across three time points is the end-of-intervention test. So both favours exergame and other can be read from the protocol. The user's question: does a composite whose construction and valence the paper does not state decide direction by the paper's own label (higher = more motivation), and does a time x group interaction count as the end-of-intervention between-group test? If not, which code applies (other, or not tested between groups)?
